when.en: One backend feature whose frozen contract spans more than one writer boundary: the mission names backend.generate once per module, so the planner runs backend.plan after the architecture decision and the generator fans out one module per branch under scope full; the promise is reconciled after the code lands and the session branch is published, as in backend-feature.
when.vi: Một feature backend mà contract đã đóng băng trải qua hơn một ranh giới writer: nhiệm vụ gọi tên backend.generate mỗi module một lần, nên planner chạy backend.plan sau quyết định kiến trúc và generator toả ra mỗi nhánh một module dưới scope full; lời hứa được đối chiếu sau khi code đã vào và nhánh phiên được publish, như backend-feature.

mission.goal: one backend feature of several modules lands against a decided architecture and a reconciled promise

doneWhen.evidence: the promise is modelled and published
the enrolment module of the contract is filled on the session branch
the access module of the contract is filled on the session branch
the promise is reconciled against the delivered source
the session branch is merged and pushed

rewrite: New in 2.0.1: the plan/execute pair for backend. backend-feature with two backend.generate lines: backend.plan takes the frozen architecture-decision and precedes the one backend.generate branch, which fans out by module.
